relayHistoryMigrations.evidence: 2026-11-03 GKE drill: relayhistory-cloud 74a6e526 has 47 packages/relayhistory/db/migrations/*.sql; the image built from it (sha256:72a057c27edbec53412a2b3a665913810b5d9a95d8b6b818946f1892590147bf, the live-proof RelayHistory image) has 47 *.sql in /app/db/migrations, and after install and after the 0.3.0 upgrade the sessions.__migrations ledger had 47 rows with 47/47 checksums equal to the file hashes (release-lane drill evidence migrations/relayhistory-previous.json, relayhistory-post-upgrade.json). This is NOT the RelayHistory image in customer-images.yaml (4b5839f proof image) and NOT a release image: the release image is unpublished (relayhistory-cloud #280 held). The revision intentionally differs, so the release gate rejects this record (relayhistory-migrations) until migration evidence is recorded for the released image.

restore.evidence: 2026-11-03 GKE drill: charts/agent-relay/scripts/gcp-recovery-backup.sh captured ar-20261103T181010Z-manual with writes quiesced for 314 s (writesQuiesced=true, artifactsComplete=true). The locked 35-day archive bucket holds the 3 Cloud SQL exports, the GCS copy and the evidence, including the snapshot handles; the Cloud SQL backup is held by Cloud SQL, and the Relaycast and RelayAuth PVC snapshots were Kubernetes VolumeSnapshots with a Retain policy, outside the bucket (deleted at drill cleanup). Restored into a separate Cloud SQL instance, bucket, namespace and PVCs from imported snapshots. All 7 verification gates recorded in restore.json passed: cloudSql (migration ledgers match, runtime/migration roles separate), relaycastIntegrity and relayauthIntegrity (PRAGMA integrity_check ok), gcsIntegrity (names/sizes/CRC32C), isolatedMessaging (known agents and DM, new two-agent ping/reply), crossWorkspaceDenied, noProductionReferences. The same run also checked recorded images, session list/replay/search and idempotent delivery retry (docs/selfhost-backup-restore.md verification checks). No data loss between the quiesce point and the capture (quiesced capture; RPO under live writes not measured). RTO 387 s to Ready / 578 s to gates passed; a cold restore adds about 189 s of instance creation (about 767 s). The first delivery-gate attempt failed on a harness bug and is recorded. The restore was of the PREVIOUS release (0.1.1, its images), not 0.3.1. Artifact: drill-restore-ar-20261103T181010Z-manual.tar.gz.

upgrade.evidence: 2026-11-03 GKE drill, isolated namespace: helm upgrade from agent-relay 0.1.1 (helm-charts db747f1) to the release candidate, then versioned 0.3.0 (before the upstream 96bulls -> sessions-pipeline chart rename that the published 0.3.1 also contains) with values-gcp.yaml plus a drill overlay, gated by scripts/selfhost/pre-upgrade-check.sh (rc=0, recovery set ar-20261103T181010Z-manual, backward-compatible, side-by-side-restore). Pods Ready in 23 s, no migration re-run; 17/17 post-upgrade checks passed (Relaycast DM + agents, control-plane org + workspaces, session list/replay/search, sessions pipeline, cross-workspace denial, dashboard healthz + runtime-config, API/History/Relaycast health). PARTIAL against this manifest: the dashboard ran the release image, relaycast and relayauth the release pins; selfhost-api ran the previous image (release package private, not pullable), RelayHistory and Sessions ran live-proof images (release images unpublished). imageManifestSha256 is the sha256 of the drill image overlay actually used, so the gate correctly reports it as not tested against customer-images.yaml. Artifact: drill-upgrade-agent-relay-drill-0.1.1-to-0.3.0.tar.gz.
